θ(t) = θ₀ + ω₀ t + (1/2) θ''(0) t² + O(t³)

ω(t) = ω₀ + θ''(0) t + O(t²)

ω(0.01) ≈ 0.3093571316129251 rad/s

Higher-order corrections are small (t²/2 ~ 5×10^{-5}, even for typical g/l ~10 rad/s²), but precisely unknowable here.
